versions.text: Criterion: Verify that wings-level turn with the designated side force controller is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.2.3.12 Wings-level turn. b. 5.2.3.12.1 Dynamic response to direct side force controller (see table LXXVII for guidance). c. 5.2.3.12.2 Steady-state response to direct side force controller. d. 5.2.3.12.3 Direct side force controller forces and displacements. e. 5.2.3.12.4 Crew restraints. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.
